notes: httpCredentials supplies one Redacted password pair, optionally restricted to an HTTP(S) origin. User auth routes take precedence; one automatic attempt across a request and its redirect chain, never for proxy challenges. Arrays of origin-specific pairs are not accepted. Chromium intercepts requests only in the configured context, which can affect request timing. Firefox cancels ambiguous website/proxy challenges without either automatic pair.

decision.quote: Context HTTP credentials supply one default pair with an optional origin restriction; auth routes select different pairs for different origins.
